catalog-small.eventDescription: One completed supplier catalog or spreadsheet, including OCR/parsing, QA gates, structured outputs, and audit files.

catalog-medium.eventDescription: One completed supplier PDF with 51–200 pages, including OCR/parsing, QA gates, structured outputs, and audit files.

catalog-large.eventDescription: One completed supplier PDF with 201–500 pages, including OCR/parsing, QA gates, structured outputs, and audit files.

catalog-screening.eventDescription: A file classified as a technical/statistical non-catalog document and intentionally returned without fabricated product rows.
